name: spend-guard
description: Stops a Claude Code session just before a reply would bill usage credits, until you send /spend-guard off.

hooks.command: bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/main.ts" hook || { echo "spend-guard could not run its hook and stopped to be safe. Check that bun is on your PATH, or run: claude plugin disable spend-guard" >&2; exit 2; }
